caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate jug or pitcher, predominantly shaded in blue tones. The pitcher features a wide, rounded base decorated with broad vertical fluting, and a narrow neck that flares outward to form a wide spout. The handle is substantial and intricately adorned with swirling patterns, extending from the rim to the midpoint of the body. Around the center of the jug, there is a horizontal decorative band resembling a garland or foliage, which separates the upper and lower sections. The main body of the pitcher displays a detailed scene featuring six human figures: a standing person in a hat holding an object to their mouth, several seated figures—one embracing another, one resting their feet on a stool, and two interacting. There are also two dogs depicted near the lower part of the scene, with household objects like a plate or plaque arranged around them. The jug's upper edge features further swirling, floral-like ornamentation, and the entire illustration is rendered with fine, delicate lines and shading, giving a lightly sketched appearance, all set against an off-white or light beige background.
title: Beer Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
